description: Verify that DUT emits ICMP Destination Unreachable / Port Unreachable when a UDP datagram arrives on a port without a pending LISTEN call (RFC 1122 §4.1.3.1 SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 1122 §4.1.3.1 says a host SHOULD send ICMP Type 3 Code 3 (Destination Unreachable / Port Unreachable) for UDP datagrams whose destination port is not bound. This signals to the sender that the message went to a closed door — useful for fail-fast above UDP.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram aimed at a port with no LISTEN call

2. Observation (BPF=icmp):
   • DUT → Tester: ICMP
     - type = 3 (Destination Unreachable)
     - code = 3 (Port Unreachable)
     - src_ip = DUT IP   ← key check (uses ICMPv4 dispatch helper for uniform capture)

[Pass condition]
DUT emits ICMP Type 3 Code 3 within the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_icmp — DUT emitted some other ICMP (e.g. Type 3 Code 0 Net Unreachable, or unrelated type)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ICMP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted ICMP Port Unreachable for the unbound port — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_icmp: DUT emitted an ICMP that was not Port Unreachable
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT ICMP Port Unreachable within the listen window
